sources.snippet: Model description These are zehen8716/ritika-lora DreamBooth LoRA weights, trained on krea/Krea-2-Raw. The weights were trained using DreamBooth with the Krea 2 diffusers trainer. Krea 2 ships as two checkpoints: RAW (the non-distilled base you fine-tune on) and Turbo (an 8-step distilled checkpoint for fast, high-quality inference).
